# [STORY] As a user, I want AI-generated movie recommendations, so that I can discover catalog movies suited to my taste

## User Story
**As a** user
**I want** to see AI-generated movie recommendations based on my own viewing/rating history
**So that** I can discover catalog movies suited to my taste without searching manually

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a logged-in user with rated/favorited movies, when they open the Recommendations view, then the frontend calls `POST /api/v1/ai/recommendations` with their recent movies and renders the ranked, explained results (`aiApi.getMovieRecommendations`, `Recommendations.jsx`; `AI.test.js`/`Recommendations.test.jsx` success-path tests)
- [x] Given a user with no rating/favorite history yet, when they open the Recommendations view, then the frontend shows a clear empty state instead of an empty or erroring list (`Recommendations.test.jsx: "shows a distinct empty-history state..."`)
- [x] Given the ai-service call fails or times out, when the Recommendations view is open, then the frontend shows a graceful error state, not a blank screen or unhandled crash (`Recommendations.test.jsx: "shows a distinct error state..."`)
- [x] Given recommendations are returned, when displayed, then each includes the explanation ai-service provides, not just a bare movie card (`Movie.jsx`'s optional `caption` prop; `Recommendations.test.jsx: "renders each recommendation with its ai-service explanation text..."`)

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)
